documents.title: The Grand Adventure: From Coding Machines to Nurturing Young Minds
documents.summary: How a software leader at Zoho & Wipro realized the most powerful operating system in the universe is the human heart and mind.

slides.title: Hello Young Explorers! Meet Teacher Lakshmipriya
slides.subtitle: A story about curiosity, computers, and finding your true superpower
bulletPoints: Ever wondered how your favorite games and apps run behind the screen?
I spent over 9 years writing lines of code to make computers talk to each other across the world!
I worked at Zoho Corporation and Wipro Technologies building massive systems for telecom and retail.
Yet, the most fascinating discovery of all wasn't in computer chips—it was inside YOU!
slides.quote: Code gives structure to silicon, but love and curiosity give light to life.

slides.title: The Zoho & Wipro Years: Crafting Software with Care
slides.subtitle: How learning engineering teaches patience and problem solving
bulletPoints: At Zoho (AdventNet), I led engineering teams building WebNMS (Network Management Systems).
Automated software packaging and developed Internationalization (I18N) so people anywhere could use our tools.
At Wipro, engineered the BEAST system for Best Buy USA, connecting major telecom networks like Verizon and AT&T.
Lesson for kids: When a bug appears in code or math, don't give up! Treat it like a detective mystery waiting to be solved.
slides.quote: Mistakes are simply experiments that haven't finished teaching us yet.

slides.title: The Big Leap: Answering the Calling of the Heart
slides.subtitle: Transitioning from programming machines to nurturing human souls
bulletPoints: In 2009, I completed my MBA in Human Resources, and later earned my Master's in Psychology.
Studied Early Childhood Education and traditional Indian Knowledge Systems.
Discovered that when a child feels heard, safe, and encouraged, their imagination has no limits.
Founded 'Take Your Flight' and co-founded 'Self to Self' to help every person soar.
slides.quote: Every child is born a natural genius; our job is simply to keep their wonder alive.

documents.title: Integral Education: Wonders of Sri Aurobindo Ashram
documents.summary: Insights from serving as Counsellor and Mental Education Curriculum Developer in Pondicherry.

slides.title: The Shankar Chetty Heritage Home & Service
slides.subtitle: Learning history, values, and community connection
bulletPoints: Served as volunteer and fundraising coordinator at Sri Aurobindo Shankar Chetty Home in Pondicherry.
A sanctuary of peace and the first historical residence of Sri Aurobindo upon reaching Pondicherry.
Helped raise funds for heritage preservation and annual service activities.
Key Takeaway: True strength comes from giving back to the community and honoring sacred spaces.
slides.quote: To serve without expecting reward is the sweetest joy in the world.

slides.title: Ashram Kindergarten: A Gentle Sanctuary for Little Hearts
slides.subtitle: Student, parent, and teacher guidance for holistic growth
bulletPoints: Kindergarten should feel like sunshine—filled with laughter, colors, and freedom to explore.
Provided behavioural interventions and compassionate support for children with learning differences.
Helped parents understand emotional development rather than placing academic pressure.
Guided teachers to spot unique natural talents in each child instead of comparing them.
slides.quote: A flower does not compete with the flower next to it. It just blooms.

slides.title: Ashram Big School: Mental Education Curriculum
slides.subtitle: Designing educational materials inspired by integral development
bulletPoints: Developed mental education curricula combining logic, concentration, and inner calm.
Created engaging student worksheets, facilitator manuals, and active games.
Taught children how to quiet their minds, observe their thoughts, and make kind choices.
Integrated scientific reasoning with ethical values and Indian wisdom.
slides.quote: When the mind is quiet, the brightest stars of thought can shine.

documents.title: Take Your Flight: Brain Power, Astromath & Life Skills

slides.title: Astromath & Memory Enhancement
slides.subtitle: Playing with numbers, cosmic rhythms, and brain gym exercises
bulletPoints: Combines astronomical cycles, Vedic mathematical patterns, and brain hemisphere stimulation.
Interactive number games that eliminate math anxiety in elementary and middle schoolers.
Memory palace techniques to remember facts easily without cramming.
Attention improvement rituals to stay focused during study sessions.
slides.quote: Math is the rhythm of the cosmos; when you play with it, numbers dance!

slides.title: Conflict Resolution & Friendly Communication

bulletPoints: Teaches kids emotional labeling: 'I feel angry because...' instead of slamming doors or yelling.
Active listening games where children practice stepping into each other's shoes.
Decision-making frameworks: Thinking about the short-term feeling vs long-term consequence.
Building confidence for stage speaking, class presentations, and group discussions.
slides.quote: Gentle words can soften the hardest rock.

slides.title: Empowerment, Stress Relief & Healthy Living

Ayurvedic lifestyle guidance: sleeping well, eating fresh foods, and connecting with nature.
Special programs on the Power of Women and youth leadership.
Inspiring young girls to embrace STEM engineering and creative humanities together.
slides.quote: You have wings of wisdom and wings of effort—open them and take flight!

documents.title: Software Engineering & Enterprise Leadership
documents.summary: Deep dive into 9+ years of enterprise Java, MVC client frameworks, and international systems.

slides.title: Enterprise Architecture at Zoho Development Center
slides.subtitle: WebNMS Network Management Systems & Java Client Framework
bulletPoints: Developed modular enterprise Java applications for large-scale network monitoring.
Crafted Java Swing Client Framework with Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture.
Created dynamic XML-based custom database views and runtime customizable menu frameworks.
Handled over 1,500 enterprise technical support requests for global customers.
slides.quote: Clean architecture is not an accident; it is the art of intentional simplicity.

slides.title: Carrier Integrations at Wipro for Best Buy USA
slides.subtitle: The BEAST Platform: North America's leading retail activation system
bulletPoints: Integrated Point-of-Sale (POS) systems across thousands of Best Buy retail stores.
Seamless live integration with Verizon, Sprint, AT&T, T-Mobile, and Virgin Mobile.
Modernized legacy database interactions into scalable web service architectures.
Maintained zero-downtime reliability for millions of retail mobile activations.
slides.quote: Reliability is the greatest feature any engineer can ship.
